lines.text: برهنه شود و بهر طرفی فتنه و آشوب خیزد و نهب و فساد و غارت بود و حال علما ضعیف
lines.en: will become bare, and in every direction sedition and tumult will arise, and there will be plunder, corruption, and pillage, and the condition of the scholars will be weak

lines.text: گذرد و گرانی طعام بود (باب سیم در احکام تحویلات کواکب ببروج اثنی عشر)
lines.en: and food will be expensive. (Chapter Three: On the judgments of the transfers of the planets to the twelve signs)

lines.text: و آن مشتمل است بر نه فصل اولا بر اذهان مستقیمه مخفی نماند که مقتضی تحویلات و انتقال
lines.en: And it consists of nine sections. Firstly, let it not remain hidden from upright minds that the requirement of the transfers and the transition

lines.text: کواکب از برجی ببرجی از جمله اعاظم ارکان احکام است زیرا که تحویل کواکب از برجی ببرجی
lines.en: of the planets from one sign to another is among the greatest pillars of judgments, because the transfer of the planets from one sign to another

lines.text: بمنزله نقل شخصی است از شهری بشهری یا از منزلی بمنزلی که هر آینه او را در آن شهر
lines.en: is like the moving of a person from one city to another, or from one dwelling to another, such that inevitably for him in that city

lines.text: یا منزل وضعی مجدد و حالتی تازه روی نماید موافق مقتضای آن برج نسبت آن کوکب
lines.en: or dwelling a renewed situation and a fresh condition will appear, in accordance with the requirement of that sign in relation to that planet

lines.text: از خانه و شرف و وبال و هبوط و طبایع و کیفیات و هم چنین سعادت و نحوست ضمنا
lines.en: from domicile, exaltation, detriment, and fall, and natures and qualities, and likewise beneficence and maleficence implicitly

lines.text: خانه و ناظر و ساقط بودن او منضم بایر اوضاع از انچه مذکور شده و خواهد شد
lines.en: domicile, and its being aspecting or cadent, joined with other conditions from what has been mentioned and will be mentioned.

lines.text: (فصل اول در احکام تحویل زحل از برجی ببرجی) این وضع از زحل عظیم الاثر باشد
lines.en: (Section One: On the judgments of the transfer of Saturn from one sign to another) This situation of Saturn is of great effect,

lines.text: چنانکه از سخن اکابر قدما و محدثین ظاهر و باهر است از انجمه حکیم فاضل و راصد محق
lines.en: as is apparent and evident from the speech of the greatest of the ancients and moderns, among them the learned philosopher and verifying observer

lines.text: الدین المغربی میفرماید که اعلم انه ان انتقل زحل من برج الی برج احدث الاثار فی
lines.en: al-Din al-Maghribi, who says: "Know that if Saturn transfers from one sign to another, it produces effects in

lines.text: السماء والارض مثل الشهب و الزلازل و ینتقل الامور و یحدث الحروب و الامراض و این
lines.en: the heaven and the earth, such as shooting stars and earthquakes, and affairs change, and wars and diseases occur." And these

lines.text: احکام در بروج متفاوت میباشد صاحب حدس صحیح و ذهن سلیم داند که چه باید
lines.en: judgments are different in the signs. The possessor of correct intuition and sound mind knows what must

lines.text: گفت و این حکم انتقال زحل بلکه علویین را مخصوص ماه نباید دانست هم چنانکه بر ذکی
lines.en: be said. And this judgment of the transfer of Saturn, rather of the two superiors, must not be considered specific to the month, just as to the intelligent

lines.text: ظاهر است (احکام حلول زحل در برج حمل) دلالت کند بر حرکت پادشاه بقصد محاربه
lines.en: it is apparent. (Judgments of the entry of Saturn into the sign of Aries) It indicates the movement of the king with the intention of war

lines.text: و تحویل از موضعی بموضعی و عزل ولاة و مرگ جوانان و فتنه و حرب و غارت و قتال و
lines.en: and transfer from one place to another, and the dismissal of governors, and the death of youths, and sedition, war, plunder, and killing, and

lines.text: اسیری و اعتقال خاصه در نواحی مشرق و جنوب و کثرت اراجیف و بسیاری حشرات
lines.en: captivity and imprisonment, especially in the eastern and southern regions, and the abundance of false rumors, and the multitude of insects

lines.text: الارض خاصه موش و مور و عزت اطعمه و نزول شبنم و مضرت رسیدن بعظماء اذربایجان
lines.en: of the earth, especially mice and ants, and the dearness of foods, and the descent of dew, and harm reaching the great ones of Azerbaijan

lines.text: و فوت و موت در ولایت روم و عموم ظلم و جور در اکثر بلاد و ستم ملوک و حکام بر رعایا
lines.en: and passing away and death in the province of Rum, and the generality of oppression and tyranny in most cities, and the injustice of kings and rulers upon the subjects

lines.text: و بیماری فرهاندهان و ظلمت و تباهی هوا و نقصان سرما و حدوث بارندگی و رنج
lines.en: and the illness of commanders, and the darkness and corruption of the air, and the decrease of cold, and the occurrence of rainfall, and the suffering

lines.text: حیوانات كوچك و زحمت پیران و کشاورزان و ارباب بیوتات قدیمه و ضعف حال
lines.en: of small animals, and the trouble of the elderly and farmers and the owners of old houses, and the weakness of the condition

lines.text: کوه نشینان و سیاهان و مردم کثیف و اگر در طرف شمال بود هر مر کو بد شد
lines.en: of mountain dwellers and blacks and dirty people. And if it is in the northern direction, every pasture will become bad

lines.text: گرما و قلت سرما بود در وقت و اگر در طرف جنوب بود شدت برد و کثرت تگرگ و
lines.en: heat and lack of cold will be in time. And if it is in the southern direction, the severity of cold and the abundance of hail and

summary.headline: Saturn’s Transfer into Aries
summary.text: Chapter Three explains planetary transfers between the twelve signs as a foundation of astrological judgment, relating each transfer to domicile, exaltation, detriment, fall, aspects, and beneficence or maleficence. It begins the judgments of Saturn’s transfer, citing al-Dīn al-Maghribī and describing Saturn’s entry into Aries as bringing war, disease, unrest, famine, regional disasters, and oppressive rule.
